data.statement: Hebrews identifies Jesus as High Priest according to the order of Melchizedek.
data.disputed: No — regarding what Hebrews explicitly states
data.interpretive_divergence: Begins when determining the ecclesiological implications of the claim.

provenance.label: Finding
provenance.detail: Hebrews explicitly connects Jesus' priesthood with a changed covenantal order.

provenance.label: Claims used
provenance.detail: Psalm 110 priesthood declaration; Hebrews Melchizedek identification.

provenance.label: Supporting evidence
provenance.detail: Hebrews 7:11-19 argument on perfection through the Levitical priesthood.

provenance.label: Primary source
provenance.detail: Hebrews 5:6; 6:20; 7:17 in the Greek text and early manuscript witnesses.

provenance.label: Covenant relationships
provenance.detail: Sinai → priesthood → prophetic promise → New Covenant.

provenance.label: Doctrine connections
provenance.detail: Priesthood → Melchizedek → Jesus → sacrifice → covenant → atonement.

provenance.label: Interpretations
provenance.detail: Attributed readings from rabbinic, patristic, Reformed and Latter-day Saint sources.

provenance.label: Counterviews
provenance.detail: Readings that restrict the Melchizedek motif to a literary typology.
